_comment: Copy to calsync_config.json (gitignored) and fill in. 'provider' = 'google' or 'microsoft'. For Google: create an OAuth 2.0 Client (Web) in Google Cloud Console, enable the Google Calendar API, and register the redirect_uri below. For Microsoft: register an app in Entra ID (Azure AD) with delegated Calendars.Read. Once connected, KEYSTONE overlays real free/busy onto the Availability board; until then it runs on demo data.
